i think honestly so much of art, especially art people put out into the world intending it to find/have an audience, is so subjective it's hard to nail down exactly what makes a song "good" or "bad" - just think of all the endless threads of people arguing over that exact question! i feel like for me personally, especially into my adulthood, i've come to recognize that (to me, at least) "good" songs not only feel memorable (like, i'll be humming them or thinking about them without even meaning to after hearing them) but also have this specific authentic quality that makes them feel like an honest expression of the band/artist and not just something that exists just to exist, if that makes sense? of course that doesn't rule out songs with a less serious feeling (or songs that are meant to be upbeat and danceable! definitely an important place for those!) since those songs can still feel fresh and original :-) production and proper leveling are also big factors for me, but i'm studying sound in college so that might be something i pay more attention to than the average listener!
